description: Optimisation of an industrial four-pressure-level Collins nitrogen liquefaction cycle, giving 430.7 kWh per tonne of liquid nitrogen at the optimum against a reversible minimum of 173.4 kWh per tonne. 21 pages.
attribution: Arnaiz-del-Pozo, C.; Lopez-Paniagua, I.; Lopez-Grande, A.; Gonzalez-Fernandez, C. Optimum Expanded Fraction for an Industrial, Collins-Based Nitrogen Liquefaction Cycle. Entropy 2020, 22, 959. https://doi.org/10.3390/e22090959. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
notes: Stored because it is the only source found that puts a defensible number on CFG.eLN2 and, in the same table, kills CFG.rtLN2: the exergy of the product is 173.4 kWh per tonne, so a store cannot return half of the 450 kWh per tonne the model spends filling it. Both mdpi.com/.../pdf and the PubMed Central mirror return HTML to curl; the mdpi-res.com attachment path is the one that serves the file, and it is the publisher's own CDN rather than a third-party copy. The scope limit matters when citing it: the feed is gaseous nitrogen at 4 bar, so the work of separating nitrogen from air is not included.
